actions.name: assign_task_to_genie
actions.title: Assign task to genie
actions.description: Assign a task to a genie to process autonomously
actions.help: Assigns a task for your genie to process autonomously. The output includes the genie's final response and a log of all actions performed. Knowledge base retrieval is limited to public documents.

input.name: genie_handle
input.label: Genie
input.hint: The genie to assign the task to. Note: supported only for genies whose skills don't require runtime user connections or confirmations. {{#if input.genie_handle}}View selected genie here {{/if}}

input.name: task_instructions
input.label: Task description to genie
input.hint: The task description the genie will receive. Include clear instructions to ensure the genie understands how to process this task. Learn More

input.name: files
input.label: Additional context for genie
input.hint: Add up to 10 files your genie can access when handling the task, in addition to public documents in its knowledge bases.

input.name: conversation_id
input.label: Conversation ID
input.hint: Accepts a conversation ID from a previous task assignment. If provided, the genie processes the task with its prior context and continues the same conversation.

input.name: custom_metadata
input.label: Task metadata

properties.name: key
properties.label: Key
properties.hint: Enter the name without any space or special characters. Each key must be unique.

properties.name: value
properties.label: Value
properties.hint: Enter the value for the custom metadata

input.hint: Provide metadata in this task run that can be used in any skills the genie calls. This metadata is stable and excluded from the Genie context. You must define the metadata in the skill triggers as wel…

input.name: structured_output
input.label: Configure genie output for usage in this recipe
input.hint: Allow the genie to output structured data rather than plain text for use in subsequent recipe steps

actions.name: create_request
actions.title: Create approval request
actions.help: Use this action to create a new approval request in the specified data table. The information from this request will be shared with the user assigned to the approval task.

input.name: table_id
input.label: Request data table
input.hint: {{#if input.table_id}} You can view your selected data table here . {{/if}} {{#if !input.table_id}} Select TABLE_NAME_PLACEHOLDER. {{/if}}

input.name: creator_id
input.label: Created by
input.hint: Specify the User ID of the user that has initiated the request. The user must exist here

actions.name: create_task
actions.title: Assign task to user
actions.description: Assign a task to a user and wait for completion
actions.help: Use this action to assign a task to a user. The assignee will receive a prompt to approve or reject the request. The skill will wait until the task is completed or expires.

input.name: chat_trigger_handle
input.label: Genie
input.hint: The genie to process the event. For a genie with chat triggers, pick the interface that should handle it.

input.name: table_id
input.label: Request data table
input.hint: {{#if input.table_id}} You can view your selected data table here . {{/if}} {{#if !input.table_id}} Select TABLE_NAME_PLACEHOLDER. {{/if}}

input.name: request_id
input.label: Request ID
input.hint: Choose an approval request (defined in Create request action Request ID) to create a user task for. Use a datapill or enter the exact Request ID.

input.name: description
input.label: Task name
input.hint: Describe what the assignee needs to do. Use datapills to personalize the message.

input.name: assignee_email
input.label: Assignee
input.hint: Specify the user (identified by email address) to assign the task to. The user must exist here .

input.name: expires_in
input.label: Time to complete task
input.hint: Tasks expire if they aren't completed within the specified timeframe. The maximum value is 30 days.

input.name: call_id
input.label: Call ID
input.hint: Use call_id from start genie trigger

input.name: requester_conversation_id
input.label: Requester conversation ID
input.hint: Use conversation_id from start genie trigger

input.name: creator_id
input.label: Created by
input.hint: Specify the User ID of the user that has initiated the request. The user must exist here

actions.name: send_business_event
actions.title: Send business event
actions.help: Sends an event to the Genie to handle. The Genie will attempt to perform the task and send a summary to the user. If the user is not in Workato Users or does not have access to the Genie, this action will fail.

input.name: chat_trigger_handle
input.label: Genie
input.hint: The genie to process the event. For a genie with chat triggers, pick the interface that should handle it.

input.name: user_email
input.label: User email
input.hint: The email of the user that the Genie should work on this event with. User must be active and assigned access to this Genie.

input.name: notification_text
input.label: Notification to user
input.hint: The notification sent to the user before the Genie starts processing the event

input.name: business_event_data
input.label: Business event data
input.hint: The event data from the application. Your Genie will attempt to handle the event and send a summary to the user

input.name: prompt
input.label: Prompt
input.hint: Appended before the event data. This is optional and overrides Workato's standard prompt.

input.name: conversation_id
input.label: Conversation ID
input.hint: When provided, this will continue a previous conversation between the user and genie.
